supervision#r172.text: **While** a glossary-proposal is `awaiting-answer` and a question that a round of the kind `gate` gave on it has no answer, `work run` shall start no round of the kind `apply` for it.

supervision#r116.text: **When** every question that a round of the kind `formulate` gave on a capability-proposal has an answer, `work run` shall start a round of the kind `formulate` for the proposal, given the answers.

supervision#r150.text: **When** a round of the kind `apply` gives in its result an answer that the drafts it applied do not hold, `work run` shall start a new round of the kind `integrate` for the capability-proposal.

supervision#r221.text: **When** a round of the kind `apply` gives in its result an answer that the drafts it applied do not hold for a glossary-proposal, `work run` shall start a new round of the kind `integrate` for the glossary-proposal.

supervision#r151.text: **When** a round of the kind `apply` gives in its result an answer that the drafts it applied do not hold, `work run` shall start no round of the kind `formulate` for the capability-proposal until the new round of the kind `integrate` has been applied.

supervision#r141.text: **When** `work run` starts a round of the kind `integrate` for a capability-proposal that has answers, `work run` shall give the round the capability-proposal's questions and answers and the initiative's ledger, with the accepted lines of the request the initiative fulfils.

supervision#r142.text: **When** a round of the kind `integrate` drafts a capability-proposal anew from its answers, `work run` shall set the capability-proposal `drafted`, its earlier drafts kept in their round's directory.

supervision#r143.text: **When** `work run` starts a round of the kind `integrate` for a capability-proposal, `work run` shall keep the proposal's status until the round ends.

supervision#r144.text: **When** a round of the kind `apply` that `work run` started for a capability-proposal ends having applied its drafts, `work run` shall transition the proposal to `approved`.

supervision#r166.text: **When** a round of the kind `apply` that `work run` started for a glossary-proposal ends having applied its drafts, `work run` shall transition the proposal to `approved`.

supervision#r167.text: **When** a round of the kind `apply` that `work run` started for a glossary-proposal ends having applied its drafts, `work run` shall start no round of the kind `formulate` for the proposal.

supervision#r145.text: **When** a round of the kind `apply` that `work run` started for a capability-proposal ends having applied its drafts, `work run` shall write the proposal's `adds`, `changes` and `removes` from the change list the round applied.

supervision#r146.text: **When** a round of the kind `apply` that `work run` started for a capability-proposal ends having applied its drafts, `work run` shall start a round of the kind `formulate` for the proposal.

supervision#r147.text: **When** a round of the kind `apply` applies nothing because a capability-proposal's answers give what its drafts do not hold, `work run` shall take that as the round's output.

supervision#r148.text: **When** a round of the kind `integrate` drafts a capability-proposal anew from its answers, `work run` shall write no second capability-proposal for that proposal's capability.

supervision#r188.text: **When** a round of the kind `integrate` redrafts some of the lines of a capability-proposal it was started for, `work run` shall keep the requirement ids of the proposal that the round's change list does not name.

supervision#r189.text: **When** a round of the kind `integrate` redrafts some of the terms of a glossary-proposal it was started for, `work run` shall keep the terms of the glossary-proposal that the round's change list does not name.

supervision#r83.text: **When** a round of the kind `formulate` that `work run` started for a capability-proposal ends without giving a question, `work run` shall transition the proposal to `formulated`.

supervision#r186.text: **When** a round of the kind `formulate` formulates nothing because a capability-proposal's answers change lines not in `spec/`, `work run` shall start a new round of the kind `integrate` for the capability-proposal.

supervision#r152.text: **When** a round of the kind `formulate` formulates nothing because a capability-proposal's answers change lines not in `spec/`, `work run` shall keep the capability-proposal's status.

supervision#r153.text: **When** a round of the kind `formulate` formulates nothing because a capability-proposal's answers change lines not in `spec/`, `work run` shall take that as the round's output.

supervision#r86.text: **If** a round of any kind that `work run` started for a capability-proposal or an initiative ends in an error or at its turn limit, or leaves no result `work run` can read, then `work run` shall keep the proposal's or initiative's status.

supervision#r87.text: **If** a round of any kind that `work run` started for a capability-proposal or an initiative ends in an error or at its turn limit, or leaves no result `work run` can read, then `work run` shall make no transition from the round.

supervision#r88.text: **If** a round of any kind that `work run` started for a capability-proposal or an initiative ends in an error or at its turn limit, or leaves no result `work run` can read, then `work run` shall exit with an error, naming the round and how it ended.

supervision#r115.text: **If** a round of any kind that `work run` started for a capability-proposal or an initiative ends in an error or at its turn limit, or leaves no result `work run` can read, then `work run` shall take the initiative's other nodes through their transitions before it exits with an error.

supervision#r72.text: **When** a capability-proposal is `formulated`, `work run` shall draft with `work add` one work-item for each capability the proposal's `adds` and `changes` name, accepting every requirement they name on that capability.

supervision#r136.text: **While** a request that an initiative raised into an upstream is not `delivered`, `work run` shall draft no work-item for the capability-proposal whose lines it raised.

supervision#r73.text: **When** `work run` drafts a work-item, `work run` shall list under the work-item's `## Retires` each deprecated scenario whose `Deprecated for:` line names a scenario of a requirement the work-item accepts.

supervision#r123.text: **When** every work-item of an initiative is `green` or `withdrawn` and a deprecated scenario's replacement's work-item, of any initiative, is `green`, `work run` shall draft one work-item, under the capability-proposal of the last-drafted work-item whose replacement it retires, that retires each deprecated scenario whose replacement's work-item is `green`.

supervision#r124.text: **When** every work-item of an initiative is `green` or `withdrawn`, `work run` shall draft the work-item r123 names before it starts a branch review or runs `measure initiative`.

supervision#r74.text: **When** a kept branch review's result lists findings to fix now, `work run` shall draft one work-item for them, naming the findings file, under the capability-proposal that the work-item the findings concern is part of.

supervision#r121.text: **When** a kept branch review's result gives no question, `work run` shall take the review as listing nothing to fix now, whatever its status.

supervision#r110.text: **When** a work-item drafted for a kept branch review's findings turns `green`, `work run` shall start the next branch review of the initiative before `work run` exits.

supervision#r75.text: **When** every work-item of an initiative is `green` or `withdrawn` and at least one of them is `green` and its kept branch review lists nothing to fix now, `work run` shall run `measure initiative` on the initiative.

supervision#r97.text: **While** an initiative has no work-item, `work run` shall run no `measure initiative` on it.

supervision#r76.text: **When** the `measure initiative` that `work run` ran on an initiative has written its measurement, `work run` shall start a session of `analyzing-a-batch` that writes the initiative's analysis record.

supervision#r106.text: **When** `work run` has written an initiative's measurement and its analysis record, `work run` shall commit them on the initiative branch.

supervision#r213.text: **When** `work run` finds an initiative that is not `done`, that has at least one work-item that is `green`, whose every work-item is `green` or `withdrawn`, whose every capability-proposal is `formulated` or `withdrawn`, whose kept branch review lists nothing to fix now, whose measurement and analysis record `work run` has committed and whose every request kept in this context whose asker is this context and that names the initiative is `delivered`, `work run` shall set the initiative's status to `done`.

supervision#r161.text: **When** an initiative changes only the glossary, its glossary-proposal is `approved` and its terms are committed to `spec/index.md`, `work run` shall set the initiative's status to `done`.

supervision#r109.text: **When** `work run` sets an initiative's status to `done`, `work run` shall commit the initiative on the initiative branch.

supervision#r210.text: **Where** the request an initiative fulfils gives a delegation, `work run` shall give each question of the initiative that is not a question of a glossary-proposal, whatever words it uses, to a session of its own, given the delegation, the files that one question names and nothing else, which answers the question if the delegation covers it and leaves it for the person otherwise.

supervision#r211.text: **When** `work run` reads the delegation of an initiative's request, `work run` shall read the delegation the request has at that moment, given before or after the initiative started.

supervision#r209.text: **When** a question of an initiative is a question of a glossary-proposal, `work run` shall leave the question for the person, giving it to no session under a delegation.

supervision#r78.text: **Where** the request an initiative fulfils gives a delegation, **when** a session `work run` started under it answers a question, `work run` shall write the answer naming the delegation it was given under.

supervision#r118.text: **Where** the request an initiative fulfils gives a delegation, **when** a session that `work run` started under it answers a reviewer's question on a work-item with an answer that asks for a change, `work run` shall transition the work-item to `ready`.

supervision#r119.text: **Where** the request an initiative fulfils gives a delegation, **when** a session that `work run` started under it answers a reviewer's question on a work-item with an answer that accepts the work-item as it is, `work run` shall transition the work-item to `done`.

supervision#r120.text: **Where** the request an initiative fulfils gives a delegation, **when** a session that `work run` started under it answers a reviewer's question on a work-item, the session shall give in its result whether its answer asks for a change or accepts the work-item as it is.

supervision#r89.text: **If** a session that `work run` started under a delegation to answer a question ends in an error or at its turn limit, or leaves no result `work run` can read, then `work run` shall leave the question unanswered for the person.

supervision#r90.text: **If** a session that `work run` started under a delegation to answer a question ends in an error or at its turn limit, or leaves no result `work run` can read, then `work run` shall commit the session's stage directory and log lines.

supervision#r59.text: **When** more than one work-item of the initiative is `drafted` or `researched`, `work run` shall start the research or plan stage of each of them at the same time, within the number of workers r60 gives.

supervision#r60.text: `work run` shall run at most as many workers at the same time as `.shop/delivery.toml`'s number of workers, and 4 where it gives none.

supervision#r2.text: **When** a work-item's status is `drafted`, `researched`, `ready` or `done`, `work run` shall start a new `claude -p` session of that stage's agent (`code-scout`, `bdd-planner`, `bdd-implementer`, `bdd-task-reviewer`), given one brief that names the work-item, the files to read and where its result goes.

supervision#r4.text: **When** an implementer's session ends with a result that gives no question, `work run` shall merge its work-item branch into the initiative branch only if the work-item's scenarios pass on it and the whole suite passes on it but for the failing scenarios r43 counts as expected.

supervision#r6.text: **If** a worker changes a file under `.shop/work/` outside its stage directory, then `work run` shall put the file back as it was.

supervision#r7.text: **When** `work run` makes a work-item's transition, `work run` shall commit the work-item's file, its stage directories and `log.jsonl` on the initiative branch, and nothing else.

supervision#r8.text: **When** a worker starts or ends, `work run` shall append a line to `log.jsonl` with the time, the work-item, the stage, the agent and the session id.

supervision#r62.text: **When** `work run` writes a stage's `session.json`, `work run` shall record in it the path of the transcript of the stage's session.

supervision#r212.text: **When** no node of the initiative can make a transition, every work-item is `green` or `withdrawn`, no capability-proposal is `awaiting-answer` and no request whose asker is this context is in the asker's turn, `work run` shall exit successfully, printing each work-item's status.

supervision#r101.text: **When** `work run` ends while a request kept in this context whose asker is this context is in the asker's turn, `work run` shall exit with an error, printing the request with its open questions.

supervision#r184.text: **When** `work run` ends with a capability-proposal or a work-item `awaiting-answer`, `work run` shall exit with an error, printing each with its open questions.

supervision#r52.text: **When** no work-item can make a transition and a work-item is `failed`, `work run` shall exit with an error, printing each work-item's status and each fault.

supervision#r81.text: **When** `work run` was started with no initiative, no node of an initiative it took can make a transition and one such node is `awaiting-answer` or `failed`, `work run` shall exit with an error, printing the status of each initiative it took.

supervision#r82.text: **When** `work run` was started with no initiative, no node of an initiative it took can make a transition and none is `awaiting-answer` or `failed` and no request whose asker is this context is in the asker's turn, `work run` shall exit successfully, printing the status of each initiative it took.

supervision#r53.text: **If** the push after the branch review's commit fails, then `work run` shall exit with an error, saying why.

supervision#r54.text: **When** `work run` starts and the initiative branch has commits its remote does not have, `work run` shall first push the initiative branch to the remote.

supervision#r10.text: **If** `work run` cannot start the delivery it was asked for, then `work run` shall exit with an error, say why, and change nothing.

supervision#r11.text: **When** `work run` starts a worker, `work run` shall give the worker this plugin's own directory as its plugin.

supervision#r12.text: **When** `work run` starts a worker whose agent lists skills, `work run` shall allow the worker to load each of those skills.

supervision#r13.text: `work run` shall give no worker a bare Write or Edit tool.

supervision#r14.text: `work run` shall allow a worker's Bash only `python3 -m pytest`, the plugin's scripts its stage runs, by path, and the git commands its stage needs.

supervision#r15.text: **When** `work run` removes a worker's worktree, `work run` shall first copy each file the worker's result names into its stage directory.

supervision#r17.text: **When** `work run` writes a worker's brief, `work run` shall tell the worker that it starts in its worktree and never changes directory.

supervision#r18.text: **When** `work run` merges a work-item branch, `work run` shall delete that branch.

supervision#r19.text: **When** `work run` starts a researcher, `work run` shall give it the work-item's file set and accepted scenarios and a limit of 80 turns.

supervision#r20.text: **While** ready work-items have claims that share no file, `work run` shall have them implemented at the same time, each in its own worktree, within the number of workers r60 gives.

supervision#r61.text: **When** implementers working at the same time end, `work run` shall merge the work-item branches that r4 merges into the initiative branch one at a time, in the order the implementers ended.

supervision#r21.text: **If** `work run` is started by a worker of another `work run`, then `work run` shall refuse, saying so.

supervision#r22.text: `work run` shall give every pytest command it starts, and every worker's, the plugin's option `--work-item <name>`, which selects the scenarios the work-item accepts.

supervision#r55.text: **When** a pytest command given `--work-item <name>` collects a test that is not a scenario, the option shall keep that test.

supervision#r56.text: **If** a pytest command given `--work-item <name>` collects scenarios and none that the work-item accepts, and a requirement the work-item accepts is not of a guarantees capability, then the option shall refuse, saying so.

supervision#r64.text: **When** a pytest command given `--work-item <name>` collects scenarios and none that the work-item accepts, and every requirement the work-item accepts is of a guarantees capability, the option shall deselect each scenario it collects.

supervision#r65.text: **When** a pytest command given `--work-item <name>` for a work-item every requirement of which is of a guarantees capability is left with no test, the command shall exit successfully.

supervision#r23.text: **Where** the repository is inside the plugin's own directory, `work run` shall make each worker's worktree in a temporary directory outside it.

supervision#r24.text: **When** `work run` starts an implementer, `work run` shall first run the whole suite in the implementer's worktree and say in the brief how it ended.

supervision#r25.text: **When** `work run` writes a worker's brief, `work run` shall name in it the plugin's scripts directory, the initiative branch's base, the worker's worktree and its work-item branch.

supervision#r57.text: **When** `work run` writes the brief of a worker for a work-item that has answers, `work run` shall write each of the work-item's answers, with the question it answers, in it.

supervision#r98.text: **When** `work run` starts an implementer for a work-item that an answer to the question of a work-item's reviewer returned to `ready`, `work run` shall give the implementer the reviewer's findings and the answer.

supervision#r26.text: **When** `work run` makes a work-item's transition to `awaiting-answer`, `work run` shall keep the work-item branch.

supervision#r58.text: **When** `work run` starts an implementer for a work-item whose work-item branch it kept, `work run` shall make the implementer's worktree on that branch.

supervision#r27.text: **When** every work-item of the initiative is `green` or `withdrawn` and the initiative branch holds a commit, other than a kept branch review's own commit, that no kept branch review has read, `work run` shall start a `claude -p` session of `bdd-branch-reviewer` over the initiative branch from its base, given one brief.

supervision#r154.text: **When** `work run` starts a branch review, `work run` shall first run, at the initiative branch's head, the whole suite, each work-item's scenarios, each check a work-item names, `tools check`, `tools size`, `features deprecated` and `features bindings`.

supervision#r155.text: **When** `work run` starts a branch review, `work run` shall give the branch reviewer each run r154 names with its command, how it exited and its output, naming the commit they ran at.

supervision#r156.text: **When** `work run` starts a branch review, `work run` shall give the branch reviewer the commits from the initiative branch's base to its head, each with the work-item it belongs to or none, and the change of that range less `.shop/`.

supervision#r157.text: **When** `work run` starts a branch review, `work run` shall give the branch reviewer the files to read: the capabilities the work-items are under, the design-decisions those capabilities rest on, and each work-item's plan, implementer's report and review findings.

supervision#r47.text: **When** the branch reviewer's session ends, `work run` shall copy its directory into `.shop/work/<initiative>/runs/branch-review/<k>/`.

supervision#r48.text: **When** the branch reviewer's session ends, `work run` shall commit `.shop/work/<initiative>/runs/branch-review/<k>/` on the initiative branch.

supervision#r49.text: **When** the branch reviewer's session starts or ends, `work run` shall append a line to `log.jsonl` with the time, the stage `branch-review`, the agent and the session id.

supervision#r50.text: **While** every commit on the initiative branch other than the kept branch reviews' own commits has been read by a kept branch review, `work run` shall start no branch review.

supervision#r94.text: **While** an initiative has no work-item, `work run` shall start no branch review of it.

supervision#r51.text: **If** the push verification before the branch review fails, then `work run` shall exit with an error, saying why, and start no branch review.

supervision#r214.text: **When** `work run` checks what changed in the main checkout while a session it started for one initiative worked, `work run` shall leave out each path under `.shop/work/<initiative>/` of another initiative that `work run` is running side by side.

supervision#r215.text: **If** a path under `.shop/work/<initiative>/` of another initiative that `work run` is running side by side changed, by a session of that initiative, while a session of one initiative worked, **then** `work run` shall put back no change of that path.

supervision#r216.text: **If** a path under `.shop/work/<initiative>/` of another initiative that `work run` is running side by side changed, by a session of that initiative, while a session of one initiative worked, **then** `work run` shall fault no session for that change.

supervision#r218.text: **If** the main checkout's `.shop/work/`, less each path under `.shop/work/<initiative>/` of another initiative that `work run` is running side by side, differs from its last commit when a worker ends, then `work run` shall put it back and transition the work-item to `failed`, naming each file.

supervision#r29.text: **Where** `.shop/delivery.toml` gives `[tests]`, `work run` shall run those commands in place of its own commands for the work-item's scenarios and the suite.

supervision#r30.text: **Where** `.shop/delivery.toml` gives a stage's `[allowed_tools]`, `work run` shall give that stage's worker that list in place of its own, less any bare Write or Edit.

supervision#r31.text: **When** a planner's result gives a `fileset`, `work run` shall write that file set into the work-item as `fileset:` as it makes the work-item's transition to `planned`.

supervision#r33.text: **When** `work run` exits, `work run` shall remove every worktree it made.

supervision#r34.text: **If** a worker changes a file under `.shop/work/` outside its stage directory, then `work run` shall transition the work-item to `failed`, recording the files, its branch unmerged.

supervision#r35.text: **When** `work run` is about to start a worker or the branch reviewer, `work run` shall first verify that it can push the initiative branch to the remote.

supervision#r36.text: **When** `work run` transitions a work-item to `awaiting-answer`, `work run` shall write its question under the work-item's `## Questions`.

supervision#r37.text: **While** a work-item is `awaiting-answer` or `failed`, `work run` shall start no worker for it.

supervision#r63.text: **While** a work-item's `blocked_by` names a work-item that is not `green`, `work run` shall start no worker for it.

supervision#r38.text: **When** `work run` commits on the initiative branch, `work run` shall push the initiative branch to the remote.

supervision#r39.text: **If** the verification before a worker starts fails, then `work run` shall transition the work-item to `failed`, recording the reason, before any worker starts.

supervision#r40.text: **When** `work run` transitions a work-item to `failed`, `work run` shall exit with an error, naming the work-item and its fault.

supervision#r41.text: **If** a git command, a push included, fails during a work-item's stage, then `work run` shall transition the work-item to `failed`, recording git's reason.

supervision#r42.text: **If** a worker ends without a result file that `work run` can read, then `work run` shall transition the work-item to `failed`, recording how its session ended.

supervision#r43.text: **When** `work run` runs the whole suite before a merge, `work run` shall count as expected each failing scenario whose requirement a work-item other than the one being merged accepts and that is neither `green` nor `withdrawn`.

supervision#r122.text: **When** `work run` checks a work-item against the whole suite, `work run` shall count as expected to fail each scenario whose requirement a capability-proposal that is neither `formulated` nor `withdrawn` adds or changes.

supervision#r219.text: **If** a scenario fails in a run that `work run` makes before a merge and its failure would keep r4 from merging the work-item branch, **then** `work run` shall run that scenario again once, alone, before it refuses the merge.

supervision#r220.text: **If** the second run of a scenario that r219 makes also fails, **then** `work run` shall give both runs of the scenario in the question r131 writes for the work-item.

supervision#r222.text: **When** the second run of a scenario that r219 makes passes, `work run` shall take the scenario as passing in r4's merge of the work-item branch.

supervision#r44.text: **When** `work run` writes a worker's brief, `work run` shall tell the worker to write its result file first with the outcome `PARTIAL`, and keep it current as it works.

supervision#r45.text: **If** a worker's session ends in an error or at its turn limit, exits with an error, or leaves output that holds no JSON result, then `work run` shall transition the work-item to `failed`, recording how the session ended.

supervision#r46.text: **If** the main checkout's `.shop/work/` has uncommitted changes when `work run` starts, then `work run` shall exit with an error, naming them, and change nothing.

trials#r1.text: **When** the `trial-runner` is started with an input naming a plugin tool or `work run`, a real target or a fixture repository, and what to measure, the `trial-runner` shall run that one trial on that target.

trials#r2.text: **While** a trial runs, the `trial-runner` shall read nothing but the target and the plugin's scripts.

trials#r3.text: **While** a trial runs, the `trial-runner` shall change nothing in the repository it was started in but the measurement record it writes.

trials#r4.text: **When** the trial has run, the `trial-runner` shall write one measurement record under `.shop/records/measurements/` naming what it ran, on what target, and what it measured.

trials#r5.text: **When** the `trial-runner` has written its measurement record, the `trial-runner` shall reply naming the record.

work-queue#r1.text: **When** `work add <initiative> <title>` is run with `--part-of`, `--under` and `--accepts`, `work` shall write `.shop/work/<initiative>/w<n>.md` as a `drafted` work-item with the id `w<n>`, the fields given and the title as its `# ` heading, and print the id.

work-queue#r12.text: `work add` shall number a new work-item's id `w<n>` with `<n>` one above the highest `<n>` of any work-item under `.shop/work/`, in any initiative and any status.

work-queue#r32.text: **If** `work add` is given an initiative that is `done` or `abandoned`, **then** `work add` shall refuse, naming the initiative's status, and change nothing.

work-queue#r22.text: **When** `work start <request>` is run on an `accepted` request, `work` shall write `.shop/work/<initiative>/initiative.md` as a `proposed` initiative of kind `capability-change` that fulfils the request, with the request's origins as its source, and print its id.

work-queue#r25.text: **When** `work start` writes an initiative, `work` shall commit the initiative on the current branch.

work-queue#r62.text: **When** a `work` command's change makes it true that an initiative has at least one work-item that is `green`, that every work-item of it is `green` or `withdrawn`, that every capability-proposal of it is `formulated` or `withdrawn` and that every request kept in this context whose asker is this context and that names the initiative is `delivered`, that command shall set the initiative's status to `done`.

work-queue#r31.text: **If** every work-item of an initiative is `withdrawn`, **then** `work` shall leave the initiative's status as it is.

work-queue#r47.text: **If** every work-item of an initiative is `green` or `withdrawn` while one of its capability-proposals is neither `formulated` nor `withdrawn`, **then** `work` shall keep the initiative `started`.

work-queue#r60.text: **When** `work list` is run, `work` shall print each initiative and each work-item under `.shop/work/` with its status.

work-queue#r61.text: **Where** `--json` is given, `work list` shall print its result, each initiative and work-item with its status, as one JSON object.

work-queue#r39.text: **While** a request that an initiative raised into an upstream is not `delivered`, `work list` shall print the initiative as waiting on that request.

work-queue#r36.text: **When** `work show <initiative>` is run, `work` shall print the initiative's status, each of its capability-proposals with its status, each of its work-items with its status and its open questions, the initiative branch and whether the remote has every commit of it, each tracked file of the checkout with uncommitted changes and each untracked file of the checkout that git does not ignore, the last ten lines of the initiative's ledger, and the ledger's last line whose note, the text given to `work note` after the date `work note` writes, begins `next:`.

work-queue#r37.text: **When** `work show <work-item>` is run, `work` shall print the work-item's status and its open questions.

work-queue#r59.text: **When** `work show <request>` is run, `work` shall print the request's status, whose turn it is, its lines with their line outcomes, its questions, its answers and its resolution.

work-queue#r38.text: **Where** `--json` is given, `work show` shall print its result as one JSON object.

work-queue#r19.text: **When** `work note <initiative> <line>` is run, `work` shall append the line, with the date, to the initiative's ledger `.shop/work/<initiative>/ledger.md`.

work-queue#r20.text: **When** `work note` appends a line to an initiative's ledger, `work` shall commit the ledger on the current branch.

work-queue#r21.text: **If** the line given to `work note` has in it one of Unicode's mandatory line breaks, U+000A (LF), U+000B (VT), U+000C (FF), U+000D (CR), U+0085 (NEL), U+2028 or U+2029, then `work` shall exit with an error, saying that a note is one line, and change nothing.

work-queue#r4.text: **When** `work` makes a work-item's transition, `work` shall write the new status into the work-item's file.

work-queue#r5.text: **When** `work` makes a work-item's transition, `work` shall append a line to `.shop/work/<initiative>/log.jsonl` with the time, the work-item, the status before and after, and who made the transition.

work-queue#r6.text: **If** a work-item's status in its file is not the last status `log.jsonl` gives it, then `work` shall refuse the transition, naming the file and both statuses.

work-queue#r7.text: **If** `work` cannot do what it was asked, then `work` shall exit with an error, say why, and change nothing.

work-queue#r8.text: **When** `work retry <work-item>` is run on a `failed` work-item, `work` shall transition it to the status before that `log.jsonl` gives in the work-item's transition into `failed`.

work-queue#r10.text: **When** `work withdraw <work-item>` is run on a work-item that is neither `claimed` nor `green`, `work` shall transition it to `withdrawn`.

work-queue#r13.text: **When** `work answer <work-item> <answer>` is run on an `awaiting-answer` work-item, `work` shall write the answer, with the date, under the work-item's `## Answers`.

work-queue#r24.text: **When** `work answer <capability-proposal> <answer>` is run on an `awaiting-answer` capability-proposal, `work` shall write the answer, with the date, under the proposal's `## Answers`.

work-queue#r30.text: **When** `work answer <initiative>/<name> <answer>` is run, `work` shall answer the work-item or capability-proposal `<name>` of that initiative.

work-queue#r14.text: **When** `work answer <work-item> <answer>` is run on an `awaiting-answer` work-item whose question a researcher, a planner or an implementer asked, `work` shall transition it to the status the stage that asked its question started from: `drafted` for a researcher's question, `researched` for a planner's and `ready` for an implementer's.

work-queue#r26.text: **When** `work answer <work-item> <answer>` is run, with the flag saying that the answer asks for a change, on an `awaiting-answer` work-item whose question a reviewer asked, `work` shall transition the work-item to `ready`.

work-queue#r27.text: **When** `work answer <work-item> <answer>` is run, with the flag saying that the answer accepts the work-item as it is, on an `awaiting-answer` work-item whose question a reviewer asked, `work` shall transition the work-item to `done`.

work-queue#r28.text: **If** `work answer <work-item> <answer>` is run without the flag saying whether the answer asks for a change or accepts the work-item as it is on an `awaiting-answer` work-item whose question a reviewer asked, then `work` shall exit with an error, saying that the answer must say which, and change nothing.

work-queue#r15.text: **If** the answer given to `work answer` has in it one of Unicode's mandatory line breaks, U+000A (LF), U+000B (VT), U+000C (FF), U+000D (CR), U+0085 (NEL), U+2028 or U+2029, then `work` shall exit with an error, saying that an answer is one line, and change nothing.

work-queue#r9.text: **When** `work add`, `work retry`, `work withdraw` or `work answer` changes a work-item or a capability-proposal, `work` shall commit on the current branch the changed file and the `log.jsonl` line the change made, if it made one.
